title: Toward Adaptive Non-Intrusive Reduced-Order Models: Design and Challenges
summary: Projection-based Reduced Order Models (ROMs) are often deployed as static surrogates, which limits their practical utility once a system leaves the training manifold. We formalize and study adaptive non-intrusive ROMs that update both the latent subspace and the reduced dynamics online.
